versions.content: RTE_E_IN_EXCLUSIVE_AREA  Used only for the blocking API. RTE_E_IN_EXCLUSIVE_AREA indi- cates that the runnable can not enter wait, as one of the Ex- ecutableEntity s in the call stack of this task is currently in an exclusive area, see [SWS_Rte_02739]. - In a properly configured system, this error should not occur. The check can be disabled according to [SWS_Rte_08321].
